mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS o_id, o.order_no AS o_order_no, o.user_id AS o_user_id, o.merchant_id AS o_merchant_id, m.shop_name AS o_shop_name, o.total_amount AS o_total_amount, o.pay_amount AS o_pay_amount, o.status AS o_status, o.pay_time AS o_pay_time, o.pay_method AS o_pay_method, o.receiver_name AS o_receiver_name, o.receiver_phone AS o_receiver_phone, o.receiver_address AS o_receiver_address, o.remark AS o_remark, o.create_time AS o_create_time, oi.id AS oi_id, oi.product_id AS oi_product_id, oi.product_name AS oi_product_name, oi.product_image AS oi_product_image, oi.unit_price AS oi_unit_price, oi.quantity AS oi_quantity, oi.total_price AS oi_total_price FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON o.merchant_id = m.id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id AND oi.deleted = 0 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY oi.create_time ASC
